text:
emma: heads-up: EU canary for webapp v5.0.1 failed after promote. Containers pulling OK for amd64 but arm64 returns 404 for manifest and cosign verify shows missing signatures. holding rollout.

deploybot: promote trace:
```
2026-06-09T09:42:12Z promoting redwood/webapp:v5.0.1-canary -> eu-west-1
pull manifest: ok (amd64)
pull manifest: error: manifest missing for platform arm64 (404)
attestation attach: error: metadata object not found (404)
```

alex: saw this in canary checks. ECR mirror shows replicated layers but attestation blob missing in eu repo. US side has cosign signature present.

infra-oncall: checked replication logs: eu replication job ran right when ECR GC kicked in for a short window. GC removed untagged metadata objects with created_at < now-1h; our attestation object was transiently untagged and got tombstoned during replication. This left the eu mirror with layers but no attestation, causing our pull/verify to fail and registry policy to treat manifest incomplete.

julie: options:
- rollback to pinned digest -> safe, immediate
- push eu-specific retag with fresh signature -> faster to recover, but need new tag due to immutability
- request emergency GC rollback on eu (not allowed per policy)

emma: prioritize safety. rollback canary now, stamp incident, then plan retag+resign. Alex+Infra please own the retag; I'll draft release note.

deploybot: rolling back to pinned digest sha256:5f6a7b8c9d at 2026-06-09T09:47:03Z

deploybot: rollback complete. canary now points to sha256:5f6a7b8c9d (stable)

julie: filing INFRA-3301 "ECR GC race causing attestation tombstone during cross-account replication" assigned to @infra-team. Also TASK-5110 "eu-retag-v5.0.1-temp + fresh sign & verify" assigned to @alex.

alex: starting retag pipeline: creating redwood/webapp:v5.0.1-eu-republish with fresh manifest ordering, and signing with cosign `--force` to ensure a new signature blob id.

alex: retag pushed at 2026-06-09T10:12:28Z -> redwood/webapp:v5.0.1-eu-republish

alex: cosign verify (eu mirror):
```
$ cosign verify --key kms://awskms/alias/cosign-eu redwood/webapp:v5.0.1-eu-republish
Verified OK for redwood/webapp:v5.0.1-eu-republish
Signatures: 1
```

infra-oncall: performed replication sanity: metadata present, no tombstone, GC window confirmed. We'll add a replication pre-check: if attestation object is untagged and created < 2m before GC window, hold replication. Logged as INFRA-3301 follow-up.

emma: scheduling promote to next change window 12:00-14:00 UTC. Alex schedule promote at 12:05 and post verification logs here. Release-manager: please hold the internal RN until we confirm post-canary health.

release-manager: drafting internal note:
"Internal: EU canary for v5.0.1 paused during promote due to missing attestation in mirror caused by an ECR GC race during replication. Canary rolled back to stable digest sha256:5f6a7b8c9d. A EU-specific retag with a fresh attestation (v5.0.1-eu-republish) was pushed and smoke-verified. Full canary retry scheduled in the 12:00-14:00 UTC change window. INFRA-3301 opened for long-term fix. No customer impact observed."

nikhil: small ask for changelog: add note that EU mirror may briefly show older digest until republish completes. Also add TASK-5111 to add a short delay in replication post-publish to avoid GC race.

emma: good call. Alex, please paste promote logs after 12:05 and we'll close this thread into the incident summary.

alex: will do. keeping this thread as canonical source. :white_check_mark:
